about: Groups of items that are interchangeable answers to a meaning→Japanese prompt. Reviewed by hand against the JMdict senses recorded on each item. Used two ways: (1) a typed answer from the same group is accepted (with a note naming the word being practised); (2) members of a group are never used as each other's distractors. Register differences are noted; meaningful distinctions (暑い/辛い, 寒い/冷たい, そこ/あそこ) are deliberately NOT grouped.
